description_short: Build smooth two-lane highways with terrain ramps, intersections, roundabouts, and automatic routing.
description_long: Highway Roads adds smoothly planned, two-way highways for road vehicles. The multi-pivot construction tool supports flowing curves, repeated S-bends, tangent-continuous extensions, terrain-following elevation ramps, and exact snapping to free network ports. Clicking a junction or roundabout body selects a suitable free arm, while pointing directly at an arm takes priority. Ramp endpoints remain horizontal; the planner uses its native 12.5% and 25% grades and prefers gentler ramps where space permits. Every point across the full road surface must remain within the native ground-support tolerance, so floating roads and water crossings are rejected. Dedicated tools place three-arm T intersections, four-arm + intersections, and right-hand-traffic roundabouts in all 16 planner directions. Vehicles automatically compare their normal route with reachable highway alternatives, follow the selected three-dimensional lanes through every node, and enter or leave only at horizontal transitions that match the terrain height. Road-capable vehicles can reach 140% of their normal maximum speed on highway-network entities and use 50% of their base maintenance while driving on mod roads. Controls: left-click to place the start and additional pivots, double-click to build, right-click to cancel, and Shift-double-click to continue directly from the completed endpoint. The mod can be added to existing saves, but should not be removed after highway pieces have been built.
